PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS ANALYSIS OF SYSTEMS, CONTROLS, AND LEGAL COMPLIANCE
Enterprise Risk Management

CHARTS: None

TABLES: None

DIAGRAMS:
- Title: FIGURE 2 NASA’s UNICORN
- Main Oval/Circle: Enterprise Risk Management
- Top Center Red Oval: EC (Executive Council)
- Left Blue Oval: APMC (Agency Program Management Council)
- Right Green Oval: MSC (Mission Support Council)
- Center White Oval: ASC (Acquisition Strategy Council)
- Arrows and labels connecting the councils:
  - Left green curved arrow labeled "Program & Mission Decisions"
  - Right green curved arrow labeled "Mission-Enabling Decisions"
  - Line from EC to APMC labeled "Programmatic Assessments and Recommendations"
  - Line from APMC to EC labeled "Program Strategic Guidance & Budget"
  - Line from APMC to ASC labeled "APMC Participation"
  - Line from ASC to APMC labeled "Program-derived Institutional Requirements"
  - Line from ASC to MSC labeled "Delivery of Institutional Capabilities"
  - Line from MSC to ASC labeled "Extended MSC"
  - Line from MSC to EC labeled "Institutional Strategic Guidance & Budget"
  - Line from EC to MSC labeled "Extended EC"
  - Line from EC to ASC labeled "ASC Advice and Recommendations"
- Colored horizontal risk boxes (bottom area of diagram):
  - Blue: Political and Reputational Risk
  - Blue: Programmatic Risk
  - Green: Financial Risk
  - Yellow: Strategic Risk
  - Red: Operational Risk
- Light Blue Box below risk boxes: "HQ Mission Directorate Centers Functional Organizations Supporting Center Operations"
- Green Box below light blue box: "Control Certifications-Analysis of Controls Fraud Risk Management"
- Legend at bottom:
  - Red circle: EC Executive Council
  - Blue circle: APMC Agency Program Management Council
  - White circle with black outline: ASC Acquisition Strategy Council
  - Green circle: MSC Mission Support Council

PHOTOS: None

KEY FACTS:
- OMB Circular A-123, Management’s Responsibility for Enterprise Risk Management and Internal Control, requires Federal agencies to implement ERM.
- In July 2023, the NASA Deputy Administrator directed the formation of an internal Agency Risk Management Tiger Team.
- NASA implemented an Agency Risk Management Officer (ARMO) within the Headquarters Office of Safety and Mission Assurance.
- NASA’s ARMO leads the Agency’s ERM effort in collaboration with the Quality Assurance Division within OCFO.
- NASA Unified Comprehensive Operational Risk Network (UNICORN) is NASA’s ERM framework.
